node.statement: Conditional bridge: if B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra and A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra, then the extended delta-isomorphism v from 1.3 and the validated threshold 0 <= delta+epsilon_{A_R} <= e_iso_unit from 1.4 meet every hypothesis of lem-maincb-isomorphism-unit-control. Consequently ||v(I_{B_U oplus B_V})-u_{A_R}|| <= C_iso_unit*(delta+epsilon_{A_R}) <= abs(C_iso_unit)*(K+1)*t <= D_3*t.
